propositions: The completion verifier returns a schema-invalid Dep record instead of CompletionVerdict when a dependency record appears quoted in prose before the verdict, causing fail-closed rejection

tolerant_parse selects the first parseable JSON object in document order without consulting the target schema, preferring fenced blocks, which recovers quoted dependency records over valid verdicts when both are present
The verifier's tool result (show_ticket) embeds raw JSON Dep records which are then quoted in the model's prose, creating plausibly-first parseable objects that block selection of the actual verdict

Schema-aware selection (key-overlap filtering + per-candidate validation with last-valid-wins) must ship atomically with a sentinel channel directive to avoid model-compliance making the failure more likely

All-defaults Pydantic contracts (OverlapVerdict, TicketDigest, EpicBugScreenVerdict) degenerate to empty-object or trailing-junk wins under naive schema filtering, making the screen load-bearing on shared parsers

This is the fifth recurrence of schema-blind selection failures in the same function; prior instance fixes (67ee, artsy-chain-hold, dash-lure-slag, slit-rubble-braid) all pinned layouts rather than the invariant, allowing the class to resurface
